text: {"us_status":"written","label_product":"Skyla (levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system), 13.5 mg levonorgestrel","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed current label updated 2026-03-04; full prescribing information revised 03/2023","label_section":"Warnings and Precautions, section 5.1 Risk of Ectopic Pregnancy","quote":"Evaluate women for ectopic pregnancy if they become pregnant with Skyla in place because the likelihood of a pregnancy being ectopic is increased with Skyla.","eu":"EMA/PRAC: July 2026 signal recommendation (EPITT 20251) asks Bayer/Jaydess to update SmPC 4.4 and 4.8/PL to state higher ectopic-pregnancy incidence with Jaydess 13.5 mg versus other IUSs and copper IUDs.","uk":"MHRA/GOV.UK: Jaydess is marketed/licensed in the UK; no GOV.UK MHRA 2026 ectopic-pregnancy Drug Safety Update found, while the UK SmPC already warns in section 4.4/4.8 about ectopic pregnancy but did not show the July 2026 PRAC comparative wording.","us_regulator":"FDA: public materials include the original NDA/PREA review and a 2016 pediatric FAERS safety/utilization review; the 2016 review found no new safety signals and recommended routine pharmacovigilance, and no public FDA AEMS potential-signal or Sentinel ectopic-pregnancy evaluation for Skyla was found.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=9f44ff35-e052-49cd-a1c2-0bfd87d49309","https://www.ema.europa.eu/mt/media/74874","https://www.gov.uk/drug-safety-update/levonorgestrel-releasing-intrauterine-systems-prescribe-by-brand-name","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/medicine/28672/SPC/jaydess%2013.5%20mg%20intrauterine%20delivery%20system","https://www.fda.gov/media/85815/download","https://www.fda.gov/media/96779/download","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/postmarket-drug-safety-information-patients-and-providers","https://www.fda.gov/science-research/real-world-evidence/cder-postmarketing-studies-used-real-world-evidence"]}
